purpose: Reduce the cross-register/platform confound in the first surface-SVM pilot by evaluating only pre-LLM Dharma Connection speaker blocks and leaving one complete discussion source_group out at a time.

selection.fold_rule: Hold out each eligible source_group exactly once; train on all other eligible Dharma source_groups. Every candidate author must remain represented in training.

guardrails: This is original-text closed-set attribution, not rewrite IER.
Four discussion source_groups and ten author-thread documents are a small pilot, so even a strong point estimate is not validated-for-register evidence.
All train/test folds are platform- and broad-register-matched, reducing but not eliminating topic, interlocutor, length, and thread-structure confounds.
If word-only reproduces the primary result again, treat lexical/topic signal as a material confound rather than claiming style calibration.
If character-only materially improves relative to word-only while primary remains above chance, that is stronger evidence that surface style contributes independently of topic vocabulary.
No numeric Tier-A threshold becomes operational from this pilot.

privacy.allowed_receipt_fields: source/sample identities, hashes, word counts, fold identities, predictions, decision-free aggregate metrics
